info.title: Matomo Reporting API for HeatmapSessionRecording plugin

get.description: Adds a new heatmap.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to configure.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The heatmap name shown in the reporting UI.

parameters.name: matchPageRules
parameters.description: Matching rules that define which pages contribute to this heatmap.

parameters.name: sampleLimit
parameters.description: The number of matching page views to record before the heatmap ends automatically.

parameters.name: sampleRate
parameters.description: The percentage of matching traffic to record, from 0 to 100 with up to one decimal place.

parameters.name: excludedElements
parameters.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors to exclude from the heatmap output.

parameters.name: screenshotUrl
parameters.description: URL of the page to capture for the heatmap screenshot.

parameters.name: breakpointMobile
parameters.description: Width threshold used to classify visits as mobile when device detection is unavailable.

parameters.name: breakpointTablet
parameters.description: Width threshold used to classify visits as tablet when device detection is unavailable.

parameters.name: captureDomManually
parameters.description: Whether the DOM should be captured manually instead of automatically.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional description providing additional context, such as the purpose or usage.

parameters.name: autoRepeat
parameters.description: Whether Matomo should automatically create a new heatmap once this one finishes.

200.description:
The ID of the newly created heatmap configuration.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Copies a specified heatmap to one or more sites. If a heatmap with the same name already exists, the new heatmap will have an automatically adjusted name to make it unique to the assigned site.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website that owns the source heatmap.

parameters.name: idSiteHsr
parameters.description: The ID of the heatmap configuration to duplicate.

parameters.name: idDestinationSites
parameters.description: Site IDs to copy the heatmap to. Defaults to the source site when omitted.

200.description:
The duplication result, including success state, messages, and any newly created heatmap IDs.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Adds a new session recording.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to configure.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The session recording name shown in the reporting UI.

parameters.name: matchPageRules
parameters.description: Matching rules that define which pages contribute to this heatmap.

parameters.name: sampleLimit
parameters.description: The number of sessions to record before the recording ends automatically.

parameters.name: sampleRate
parameters.description: The percentage of matching traffic to record, from 0 to 100 with up to one decimal place.

parameters.name: minSessionTime
parameters.description: Minimum time in seconds a visitor must spend on the current page before recording.

parameters.name: requiresActivity
parameters.description: Whether the visitor must interact by scrolling or clicking before the session is kept.

parameters.name: captureKeystrokes
parameters.description: Whether entered form text should be recorded. Password fields are masked automatically.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional description providing additional context, such as the purpose or usage.

parameters.name: autoRepeat
parameters.description: Whether Matomo should automatically create a new session recording once this one finishes.

200.description:
The ID of the newly created session recording configuration.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns all recorded sessions for a specific session recording.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: idSiteHsr
parameters.description: The ID of the session recording configuration to query.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

parameters.name: idSubtable
parameters.description: Visit ID to fetch recorded pageviews for one visit instead of the session list.

200.description:
The recorded sessions, or the recorded pageviews for one visit when `idSubtable` is provided.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

tags.name: HeatmapSessionRecording
tags.description: Exposes the Heatmap & Session Recording API endpoints for managing configurations and retrieving recorded activity. Heatmap coordinates use relative values: X and Y positions range from 0 to 2000, where 1000 represents 50% of the matched element. Scroll reach and above-the-fold positions range from 0 to 1000, where 100 represents 10% of the page height. idSiteHsr identifies a heatmap or session recording configuration, while idLogHsr identifies an individual recorded activity entry.
